answer: A newcomer earns standing by harvesting saffron in a shale-walled valley, logging each harvest — weight, a photo of the saffron bed, and a juniper cutting planted as a living marker, witnessed by a neighbour. Two keepers verify the log within six days, checking weight against known yield and each cutting against the grove register. A copied photo, an impossible weight, or a cutting never planted voids the season, burns the 50-credit stake and bars the sponsor a year. One honest season costs 50 credits; a thousand fakes need 1,000 stakes and 1,000 seasons of logs, each checked at the valley.
